cells.Detail: The build-side companion to the Nucleus Technical & Functional Blueprint v1.1 and the Nucleus HRMS Demo Dataset v1.0. It converts the blueprint's prose specification into process flows, process maps, field-level data and form definitions, rule registries, state machines and a build sequence that a product manager, a developer or a QA engineer can work from without re-reading either source document.

It does not restate the blueprint's reasoning, market benchmark or architecture rationale. Where a decision is already argued in the blueprint, this workbook cites the section and moves on. Both source documents remain intact and authoritative.

cells.Topic: Relationship to the two source files
cells.Detail: Blueprint v1.1 = the WHAT and WHY. This workbook = the HOW, in sequence, with every field and form named. Demo Dataset v1.0 = the worked example and the expected results. Every process step, rule and field in here carries a pointer back to one or both.

Start at 02_Process_Architecture, then 03_Process_Inventory. Use 17_Traceability to prove demo coverage and 18_Build_Backlog to sequence a sprint. Open decisions that block work are on 22_Open_Decisions.

Start at 04_Process_Steps for the process you are building, then 06_Data_Dictionary for the objects it touches, 09_Business_Rules for the rule IDs its steps cite, and 11_State_Machines for the transitions you must guard. Check 16_Reuse_Register BEFORE writing anything that looks like an approval chain, a ledger, an eligibility check, a template render or a recompute.
07_Screens and 08_Form_Fields carry every screen, every field, its validation and its persona. 21_Roles_and_RACI carries who sees what.
19_Test_Cases is seeded from the demo dataset's expected results. Every golden case names the employee record and the date from the dataset so the expected value is not invented here.
DOM-nn, e.g. TIM-02. Domain prefixes are listed on 02_Process_Architecture.
DOM-nn.s, e.g. TIM-02.4 is step 4 of process TIM-02.
RL-nnn on 09_Business_Rules. Cited by process steps and by test cases.
snake_case, matching the blueprint's object names exactly (person, assignment, attendance_day, leave_ledger...).
SCR-nnn on 07_Screens. Form field rows on 08_Form_Fields reference the screen ID.
domain.object.verb, past tense, e.g. time.attendance_day.recomputed.
CMP-nn on 16_Reuse_Register — a shared component built once and consumed by many processes.
1-26, the client's own requirement numbering, carried unchanged from Annexure A of the blueprint and from the dataset.

Eleven capabilities in this product look like eleven features and are one component each: the approval chain, the ledger, the eligibility service, the recompute worker, the template renderer, the rule pack evaluator, the blocking-item lock, the scope resolver, the outbox, the effective-dated write and the tool surface. 16_Reuse_Register lists each with every process that consumes it. A story that re-implements one of these is a defect at design time, not a delivery. If a process step says 'reuses CMP-nn', the story is a configuration of that component, not a build.
Estimates on 18_Build_Backlog assume the component exists. A backlog item whose component has not shipped yet carries the component as a dependency, not as hidden scope.

An agent may classify and draft resolutions but never change a payroll figure.
A CRITICAL flag blocks approval and cannot be waived below its configured role threshold.
Pay components form a DAG evaluated in topological order, once per employee.
Money is held as integers in the smallest currency unit; no floating point anywhere in the engine.
Proration across any month boundary sums to the full-month value.

Statutory wage base = basic + dearness allowance + retaining allowance.
Where excluded components exceed 50% of total remuneration, the excess is added back to the wage base.

A structure change can be simulated for statutory cost and take-home impact before adoption.

Gratuity and bonus provisions accrue on the statutory wage base for the journal.

After DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED, corrections happen only as arrears.
Each run emits its own journal.

A workflow instance pins its definition version; in-flight instances finish on the version they started under.

Lifecycle events generate announcements subject to the audience rule and an editorial override.

Eligibility returns a decision, a ceiling and the reasons, and the reasons are shown to the applicant.

Accepting a guarantee locks the guarantor until release.

Each recovery posts a repayment row and reduces outstanding.
